fast.runs_on: every PR push, Linux job only (plus the portable lane everywhere)

full.runs_on: nightly and gate runs (I-11/I-13/I-15), Linux conformance lane

pruning_rule: Aligned combination cases cover the multi-role subsets against a curated set of (operation, checkpoint) pairs -- the delivery loop's windows where roles genuinely interact -- and not the full cross-product. Pruned deliberately: (a) the 7-subset x 4-checkpoint x 7-operation product, of which only the pairs listed here are kept; (b) single-role sigkill cases on operations other than the three named non-attempt seeds; (c) staggered sequences beyond the two the acceptance surface cares most about. I-11 extends this set deliberately, never by product.
